decisions.decision: Mark corrupt rows with ctx.data_quality flag instead of deleting
decisions.rationale: 98K signal_ledger rows reference the window — deletion would create orphans. Flag preserves referential integrity while letting ML/backtest queries filter with WHERE ctx->>'data_quality' IS NULL

decisions.decision: Add point_gauge() factory separate from gauge()
decisions.rationale: gauge() has many .add() callers (correct UpDownCounter semantics); only 3 callsites needed .set() semantics. Changing gauge() broke pipeline. point_gauge() = create_gauge for point-in-time absolute values.
